subtitle.en: The four math domains — algebra, advanced math, problem-solving & data analysis, and geometry & trigonometry — with Desmos tactics for the adaptive test. Eight chapters, three explorers, 50 problems.

downloadsInfo.introText: Take the Digital SAT material offline. The PDF prints straight from your browser; a native Word packet with editable equation-editor math is available on request.
downloadsInfo.pdfCardDescription: All eight chapters plus every worked solution, formatted as a clean print document.
downloadsInfo.docxCardDescription: Editable .docx with real Word equations (OMML) — ready for a timed drill or a printed practice module.
downloadsInfo.worksheetLibraryText: 10 original ClipSAT worksheets with full answer keys, organized by unit — free to download and print.

testGenerator.introText: Build a randomised test from this subject’s question bank. Pick the number of questions and a difficulty, generate, then reveal the worked answers when you’re ready — or print a clean copy to hand out.
testGenerator.examDescription: Based on the 2024–2025 College Board Digital SAT: two adaptive math modules, 4 answer choices, plus student-produced responses (SPR). Calculator permitted throughout.
